metadata.title: Implement Work Item
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Implement an Azure DevOps work item based on an approved implementation plan. Reviews the plan, executes code changes, runs a self code review loop for quality, runs tests, prepares for review, and verifies CI pipeline success. Use as a standalone implementation process or as a sub-process within the SDLC orchestrator.

maxCodeReviewIterations.description: Maximum number of code review → fix iterations before proceeding

maxCiRetries.description: Maximum number of CI failure → fix iterations before proceeding

steps.name: Review Implementation Plan
steps.output: Understood plan: scope, affected files, step order, dependencies

guidance.source: Read the plan produced by the plan-work-item sub-process from parent memory

guidance.order: Dependencies/config → module wiring → feature code → infra/DevOps → tests
rules: Create/modify files as specified in the plan
Follow existing codebase patterns and conventions
Use business-domain names, not technical/infrastructure names

steps.name: Self Code Review
steps.output: Code review findings — clean or issues to fix

guidance.context: MUST run in isolated subagent context (separate window) for independent review
guidance.scope: Review all code changes from Execute Implementation step against plan, patterns, and quality standards
guidance.exitCondition: No actionable findings OR max iterations reached
guidance.onLoop: Pass review findings as context to Execute Implementation step for targeted fixes

steps.name: Run Tests
steps.output: Test results — all passing or failures identified and fixed

actions: Fix any regressions introduced by implementation
Verify new functionality works as expected

steps.name: Prepare for Review
steps.output: Clean commits, acceptance criteria verification, change summary

actions: Create commits with clear, descriptive messages
Verify all acceptance criteria are met
List any deviations from the original plan

steps.name: Verify CI Pipeline
steps.output: CI pipeline status — passed or failure details with fix context

actions: Check CI/CD pipeline status after git push
If pipeline passed → proceed to next step
If pipeline failed → extract failure details (logs, error messages)
Pass failure context to Execute Implementation step for targeted fix
guidance.exitCondition: CI pipeline passes OR max retries reached
guidance.onLoop: Pass CI failure details as context to Execute Implementation step
